name: 06426 · Essex, CT
findings: ZIP 06426 (Essex) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06426 (Essex) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06426 (Essex) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.7 times the typical level).
